prompt_text: Who is the best personal injury lawyer in Atlanta for a car accident case?
answer_verbatim:
There’s no single objectively “best” personal injury lawyer for every Atlanta car-accident case — the right attorney depends on the facts of your crash, the severity of injuries, the insurance involved, and how you prefer to work with a lawyer. I can help you find good candidates, but here are practical steps and criteria to pick the best lawyer for your situation:

What to look for
- Focus and experience: a lawyer or firm that handles auto-accident and personal-injury cases regularly, not a generalist.  
- Trial experience: many claims settle, but you want someone willing and able to take a case to trial if necessary.  
- Track record: past settlements/verdicts, peer-review ratings (Martindale-Hubbell, Super Lawyers), and client reviews.  
- Communication: clear responsiveness and a defined main contact.  
- Fee arrangement: most Atlanta PI lawyers work on contingency (typ. 33%–40% plus costs) — confirm details in writing.  
- Local knowledge: experience with Atlanta-area courts, hospitals, and claims adjusters.  
- Licensing/discipline: check Georgia State Bar for standing.

Important Georgia rule to know
- Statute of limitations for most personal injury/car-accident claims in Georgia is 2 years from the date of the crash. Don’t wait to consult an attorney.

How to verify attorneys
- Georgia State Bar, Martindale-Hubbell (peer reviews), Super Lawyers lists, Avvo, Google/BBB reviews. Ask for references and representative results.

Questions to ask at a free consultation
- How many car-accident cases have you handled? How many went to trial?  
- Who will handle my case day-to-day?  
- What results have you achieved for cases similar to mine?  
- What is your fee and what costs will I be responsible for?  
- How will you communicate updates and how often?

If you want, I can:
- Find top-rated Atlanta personal-injury lawyers and provide a short vetted list with contact info and why they might fit your case; or  
- Suggest specific questions tailored to your case to ask at consultations.

If you want a shortlist, tell me: your ZIP code, date of the accident, whether you were injured and how badly, and whether fault/insurance is disputed.
